sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up painted portrait, bareheaded and without eyewear, in a three-quarter turn toward screen-right with a slightly raised chin and serious closed mouth. Preserve the short tightly curled dark hair with gray strands, receding temples, dark brows, and the large dense rounded salt-and-pepper beard joined to a broad moustache. The original wears an olive-gray military jacket with broad open notched lapels, shoulder straps with small gold buttons/edging, small round gold decorations on both lapels, a pale gray collared shirt and a dark olive tie. Retain the visible shoulder crop, jacket overlap, shirt collar and tie arrangement, three-quarter pose, eye direction, and soft upper-left lighting with deeper shadow on the screen-right face and coat. The complete pale beige-gray to darker gray-green painted backdrop fills the rectangular canvas, including the dark shadow around the shoulders; this is not a photograph card or overlapping paper note. The exact 156x210 source has visually solid backing and alpha249..255, with no transparent exterior. The fine motifs inside the tiny gold decorations cannot be read; preserve their visible size, color and placement without inventing rank symbols or lettering.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Centered chest-up painted portrait, nearly frontal, bareheaded and without eyewear. Preserve the short close tightly curled dark hair with gray highlights, slightly receding temples, dark brows, a distinct dark moustache, a compact pointed dark chin beard and the short dark hair along the lower jaw; do not turn this into the much larger rounded beard of another source. The eyes face forward and the serious lips are slightly parted with no visible teeth. The olive-brown military jacket has open notched lapels, gold-ended shoulder straps, a small roughly triangular gold insignia on the screen-left lapel and a round gold decoration on the screen-right lapel. A pale blue-gray collared shirt and dark olive tie fill the neckline. Retain the original collar, tie, shoulder crop, face orientation, muted upper-left light and shaded facial planes. The pale beige-gray painted background darkens toward the shoulders and fills the entire rectangle, with no card, photograph frame or note overlay. The exact 156x210 source has visually solid backing and alpha249..255, with no transparent exterior. Tiny internal insignia motifs are unreadable at this resolution; describe and retain the visible gold shapes and placement without claiming exact symbols or rank.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up painted portrait, bareheaded and without eyewear, with the head turned slightly toward screen-left and the eyes looking off-camera in that direction. Preserve the short dark neatly combed slightly waved hair, dark brows, the distinct dark moustache over the upper lip, and the visibly smooth chin without a separate chin beard. The expression is composed and serious with closed lips. The original wears a dark olive military tunic with a closed standing collar, a central gold button below the collar and a visible gold button on the screen-right shoulder strap. Retain that high closed collar and tunic fastening instead of introducing an open shirt collar or necktie. Preserve the broad shoulder crop, slight three-quarter head view and the soft upper-left illumination against darker shadow on the opposite cheek and tunic. The full pale beige-gray to gray-green painted backdrop and shoulder shadow fill the rectangular image; there is no photo card, overlapping paper note or exterior cutout. The exact 156x210 source has visibly solid backing and alpha249..255. The microscopic detail within the gold buttons is unreadable and is not evidence for an additional badge or rank mark.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up painted naval portrait with an upright, nearly frontal/slightly turned head and eyes looking upward off-camera, a serious alert expression and lightly parted lips without visible teeth. Preserve the dark brows and the smooth visible upper-lip and chin appearance; there is no clearly separate moustache or beard. Hair is mostly concealed by the large white peaked naval cap, with only a small dark edge visible at the sides. Preserve the cap white crown, black band, black peak, central gold anchor-and-wreath-shaped badge and the gold leaf-like decoration across the peak. The original wears a very dark navy jacket with broad open notched lapels, a white pointed shirt collar and a black necktie; retain the original overlap, collar opening and chest/shoulder crop. There are no glasses. Preserve the pale warm gray-beige painted background, dark shoulder silhouette, upper-left light on the face and cap and shadowed jacket. This full painted background fills the complete rectangle with no photograph card, frame, paper note or transparent exterior. The exact 156x210 source is alpha255 throughout. The cap badge has a clearly visible gold anchor/wreath layout, but its tiny internal marks and precise rank identification cannot be read; preserve the visible design rather than inventing lettering or additional insignia.
